description.value:
You flood an @Template[type:burst|distance:25] area with hungry shadows that cling to creatures and twist their movements. The darkness becomes an extension of your will, reaching out to bind anyone who crosses into your domain.

All surfaces in the area are difficult terrain. Each round that a creature starts its turn in the area, it must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell] save.

  • On a failure, it takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until it leaves the area.

  • On a critical failure, it's also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round.

Creatures can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} to remove these effects.
